fields.name: Description
fields.value:
R bindings for the Foo statistical library. The package exposes a
small model-fitting API used by Diplodocus's acceptance workspace.

functions.name: experimental_summary

fit.foo_model
functions.source:
fit.foo_model <- function(x, features, target, tolerance = 1e-8, ...) {
  refitted <- fit.default(
    features,
    target,
    tolerance = tolerance,
    ...
  )
  x$coefficients <- refitted$coefficients
  x$intercept <- refitted$intercept
  x$solver <- refitted$solver
  x
}
